messages:
Maria: Postmortem follow-up: we need owners and short timelines for regression/eval additions after the incident.
Ashok: Agreed. What are the must-haves?
Maria: Minimal set: 1) regression prompt set for fallback path, 2) short burst load test to reproduce spike, 3) KV-cache eviction chaos drill in staging, 4) CI light eval gating (warn first).
Priya: I can own the regression prompts. Will land a small harness and tag evals:nonblocking. Due in 4 business days.
Linda: I'll build the k6 load scenario and a replay script. Plan: 200 concurrent users for 45-60s with staggered sequences. Due in 7 days.
Ashok: I'll run the chaos drill in staging and add a dashboard panel for p99 generation latency during evictions. Due in 10 days.
Maria: CI gating decision: start warn-only, require 2 clean runs in prod-mirroring env before flipping to blocking.
Priya: I'll include 5 scrubbed real traces (redacted) and 3 synthetic prompts: 
```
"Summarize ticket and extract actions"
"From convo history, produce concise follow-up bullets"
"Re-rank results for intent X with one-line rationale"
```
Linda: I'll add a small dockerized invoker and exact k6 command in the runbook so anyone can reproduce locally.
DevOps Bot: Please create tracking tickets and label with incident-1769001234.
Maria: I'll create JIRA tickets and link PRs here. Also adding a recurring triage line to weekly team sync to review regression results.
Ashok: Recommend adding an alert when p99 generation increases >25% during eviction tests.
Priya: ACK. I'll make the CI job post results to the evals dashboard and to this thread.
Maria: Thanks all, expected PRs/JIRA links by EOD. We'll reconvene Friday with first-run summaries.
Linda: On it :rocket:
